name: Burrata
siboNotes: High lactose content makes burrata problematic for SIBO. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms due to the fresh, unaged nature of this cheese.
preparationTips: Use lactase enzyme supplements if consuming
Start with very small portions to test tolerance
Pair with lactose-free foods to slow digestion
Choose well-aged alternatives for better tolerance
alternatives: Aged hard cheeses like Parmesan or aged cheddar
